text: The Clover at the Parks Shuttle is operated by TAG Transportation for Howard University's Office of Parking and Transportation Services. It runs between two stops: Clover @ Park and Georgia Ave & Howard Pl. On weekdays (Monday through Friday), shuttles depart Clover @ Park every hour on the hour from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, and depart Georgia Ave & Howard Pl every hour on the half hour from 6:30 AM to 11:30 PM. On weekends (Saturday and Sunday), shuttles depart Clover @ Park every hour from 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM, and depart Georgia Ave & Howard Pl every hour from 12:30 PM to 11:30 PM. All listed times are departure times.
